innovation_summary: opera-neon-spatial-workspace is a spatial-workspace specialist exploring browser-centered, multimodal, and agent-assisted interaction patterns associated with Opera Neon — treating the browser as a spatial canvas where agent work is laid out and supervised rather than hidden behind a chat transcript. Its portfolio thesis is operator legibility: if an agent is acting inside a browser, the human needs a spatial representation of what is in flight, not a log. The function atlas files it under Operator Surfaces, the same function system headed by pro-code, which makes it the browser-side companion to the estate's control-surface line. It is the sole repository in the Opera family with a recorded priority of 'P2 browser-workspace proof'; catalog signals show real work (worked_solidified, local_job_app) but the description is empty and no independent artifact was located.
